attributes.powers: Display this card and choose a character at your location to draw 2 cards from his deck. You may not play this card during an encounter.

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Restoration, change the first power to "Display this card and choose a character at your location to draw 2 cards from his deck. Discard this card at the end of the turn. You may not play this card during an encounter."
corrections.issue: Isn't it possible to nearly kill myself in order to run a sequence of two Restoration spells and some other cards to win most scenarios through a series of clockwork explorations, except when something knocks cards off my deck and actually kills me? I mean, not that I'd ever do that myself, but... Restoration is totally broken, right?
